verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at algolia.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown docs at /doc.md that tell agents to fetch the llms.txt documentation index. The llms.txt itself describes products and official clients. Algolia also ships agent-oriented resources: a 'Build with AI' guide linked from the quickstart and an official agent skills repo (CLI, MCP, crawler, migration). Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration that agents work well with these docs.
